function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Sure! Here are a few ways you can order a cake, depending on what you’re looking for:

| Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips |
|--------|----------------|--------------|------|
| **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide or local delivery, wide variety of flavors, custom designs | Visit the website or app (e.g., **Goldbelly**, **Etsy**, **Bakery.com**, **Cake Delivery**), choose your cake, add to cart, checkout | Check delivery times & fees; read reviews; order at least 24 hrs in advance for special occasions |
| **Local bakeries with online ordering** | Fresh, often handmade cakes, sometimes unique local flavors | Search “cake delivery near me” or “local bakery + online ordering” on Google or Yelp; many bakeries now have their own websites or use platforms like **Square Online** | Call ahead to confirm availability; ask about custom decorations or dietary restrictions |
| **Specialty cake shops** | Custom designs, themed cakes, premium ingredients | Look for shops that specialize in custom cakes (e.g., **Cake Boss**, **The Cake Shop**); many have online design tools | Provide clear instructions & photos if you want a specific design; confirm pickup/delivery options |
| **Grocery stores & supermarkets** | Ready‑made cakes, quick pick‑up | Many chains (e.g., **Walmart**, **Kroger**, **Whole Foods**) offer online ordering for in‑store pickup | Order a few days ahead; check for seasonal specials |
| **Subscription services** | Monthly cake deliveries (great for birthdays, celebrations) | Services like **Cakes by the Box**, **Baker’s Dozen** | Great for recurring events; check cancellation policies |

### Quick Steps to Order Online

1. **Choose a platform** – e.g., Goldbelly for nationwide delivery, or a local bakery’s site for fresher options.
2. **Select your cake** – Browse by flavor, size, occasion, or custom design.
3. **Add to cart** – Specify quantity, any custom text, and delivery address.
4. **Checkout** – Enter payment details, review shipping/delivery fees, and confirm.
5. **Track & confirm** – Most sites send a confirmation email and a tracking link.

### If You’re in a Specific City

If you let me know your city or zip code, I can pull up a list of the best local bakeries that offer online ordering or delivery. Just drop the location, and I’ll give you a tailored list!
